reason: This empirical study tests whether attention-sink head maps transfer from bf16 to 4-bit quantized models and gives calibration guidance for sink-aware edge deployment. It finds global rank correlations >=0.980 while top-k membership retention is 76.5-88.5%, and the authors explicitly state STC measures topology, not task impact. It is relevant to deploying quantized inference-time attention policies, but does not demonstrate inference latency, throughput or end-task gains; retained as borderline.
title: Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization
